clips.title: The story
paras: Harlo Barnaby is a wounded dwarven refugee residing in Menethil Harbor. Having barely escaped the slaughter when the Dark Iron clan seized Dun Modr, he now alerts travelers to the tragedy that unfolded in the northern marshes.

Harlo Barnaby lived in Dun Modr until the northern stronghold fell to a sudden, savage assault by the Dark Iron dwarves. In the chaos of the ambush, Harlo fled south toward safety, only to catch a stray axe square in the back. Knocked unconscious by the blow, he somehow survived the trek across the marshland and awoke bandaged in Menethil Harbor. Though alive, his wounds and memories of the massacre leave him unable to return, prompting him to urge Alliance adventurers to investigate the smoking ruins of his former home.
